title: Escape the War Room: 11.11 Meltdown
description: 10 PM, the night before BeliLah's 11.11 sale. Checkout is failing, login is under attack and the bill has tripled. The CEO has three questions. Three AWS Frontier Agents can answer them. You have eight minutes.

learning_recap.title: 🧠 What You Just Learned

cycle.note: AWS DevOps Agent: correlates deploys, config and telemetry to the root cause
AWS Security Agent (Continuum): finds the flaw in code and design before launch
AWS FinOps Agent (Preview): ties each cost to CloudTrail and an owner
You connect the three and tell the CEO the truth

benefits: DevOps Agent recommends the rollback; your team approves it
Security Agent caught the waived key three weeks before it leaked
GuardDuty and WAF handle the live attack; Security Agent works before launch
FinOps Agent investigates and reports; your team shuts the spend down
One rushed release explained all three alarms
